## Architecture Overview

The `Querier` interface in `prometheus/storage/interface.go` (lines 122-132) defines the core read interface with `Select(ctx context.Context, sortSeries bool, hints *SelectHints, matchers ...*labels.Matcher) SeriesSet`. Adding `SelectSorted()` requires all implementations to add this method. Note: the current `Select()` already has a `sortSeries bool` parameter.

- **`storage/fanout.go`** — NewFanout distributing queries across storages.
- **`promql/engine_test.go`** — PromQL engine tests using MockQueryable.

- **`pkg/querier/blocks_store_queryable_test.go`** — Contains `TestBlocksStoreQuerier_SelectSortedShouldHonorQueryStoreAfter` directly testing SelectSorted.
